# Apple DNS Profile Creator

> A client-side tool that generates encrypted-DNS (DoH and DoT) configuration
> profiles for iOS and macOS (iOS 27 and macOS 27). Everything happens in the browser: no data is
> uploaded, and the tool works fully offline, making it suitable for hosting
> on a home network. Apple has supported DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS
> since iOS 14 and macOS 11, but exposes no way to use them without an app
> or a configuration profile, this tool builds those profiles.

On the tool page, a configuration can start from a provider preset, and takes
up to two IPv4 and two IPv6 resolver addresses (tried in order, IPv4 first).
Its behavior and rules include skipping encrypted DNS on specified Wi-Fi SSIDs
or domains, using encrypted DNS only for listed domains, choosing the
interfaces (Wi-Fi, cellular, Ethernet) it applies to, falling back to the
network's resolver when the encrypted server is unreachable
(iOS/macOS/visionOS 26+), and preventing profile removal on supervised
devices.

Profiles from the website are NOT signed. Unsigned profiles install
identically; iOS and macOS merely label them "Not Signed" during
installation. The macOS desktop app can optionally sign them with a
certificate from the user's Keychain.

## Tool

- [The Tool]({{ site }}): Create or import encrypted-DNS configuration
  profiles. Enter resolver settings by hand, or upload an existing
  .mobileconfig (signed profiles work too, embedded settings are read
  directly).
- [Finalize / Download]({{ site }}finalize.html): Review the collected
  configurations and download the finished profile.

## Docs

- [Project Documentation](https://github.com/tofulupo/apple-dns-profile-creator#readme):
  Architecture overview, ways to run the tool, and developer setup.
